property_summary: The contract sends the exact amount specified as the second argument in sendTo.
The receiver's balance increases by exactly the amount parameter, not by 1.
After sendTo, the receiver's balance increases by the value of the amount parameter, not by 1.
After calling sendTo, the receiver's balance increases by exactly the amount parameter.
The contract can send more than 1 wei in a single transfer when amount > 1.
After any call to sendTo, the contract's balance does not increase above its initial value when called by the owner.
When called by the owner, sendTo either reverts or reduces the contract's balance by exactly the amount sent.
When called by the owner, sendTo either reverts or reduces the contract's balance by exactly the amount sent.
sendTo reverts immediately when called by any caller.
After any call to sendTo by the owner, the contract's balance either stays the same (if the call reverted) or decreases by exactly the amount sent (if the call succeeded).
